module: WebSocket server backend selector of lua-websockets. Returns a table whose __index loads 'websocket/server_copas' or 'websocket/server_ev' on demand according to the requested name (server.copas, server.ev); any other name returns nil.
usage:
local server = require('libs/lua-websockets/websocket.server')
server.copas.listen({port = 8080, default = function(client) end})
notes: The backend is cached in the table after the first access.
